description_zh: 单猫或同家庭猫咪入住，提供独立休息区、玩耍与日常观察，并每日发送图文与视频。
description_en: Safe in-home boarding with daily reports, photos, videos, and behavior updates.

description_zh: 按计划上门喂食、换水、清理猫砂、互动陪伴，并记录饮食和排泄状态。
description_en: In-home feeding, litter care, medication support, and mood/activity updates.

description_zh: 口服药提醒、恢复期观察、老年猫细致照护。具体方案按猫咪情况评估。
description_en: Medication reminders, senior cat care, and post-treatment observation plans.

description_zh: 支持 Downtown Vancouver、Burnaby、Richmond 部分区域，视排班确认。
description_en: Limited-area transport support in Downtown Vancouver, Burnaby, and Richmond.
